scoring_justification: Step_01 thermodynamic parameters are recomputed from material constants (T1). Step_02 nucleation rate logarithms are compared against paper-reported gold with tolerance (T0) because a full recompute of the nucleation rate from raw artifacts would require extensive code not suitable for the checker sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Material constants for recomputing step_01 and paper-reported ln_J_n for step_02
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper values and formulas (step_01), and directly from Table 6 (step_02).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's published results and are the correct reference for reproduction.

required.Pd43Ni10Cu27P20: object with fields epsilon_ls0, epsilon_lgs0, delta_epsilon_0, T_0m, T_0g, Delta_Cp_Tg, T_K (all numeric)

Steady-state nucleation rate logarithm at the Kauzmann temperature.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares submitted values to the paper-reported gold using tolerances. Units are Kelvin for temperatures, J/mol/K for specific heat jump, and dimensionless for logarithms.
